title: About
text:
Last Updated: 2026-10-10
TL;DR The process is the goal, so the ideas, writing, photos, and code are mine. I will not be using any generative AI on this site. If this changes, I will update this notice here.
My thoughts on AI
My feelings about using AI are complicated. On one hand, AI can be a genuinely useful tool for breaking down concepts beyond textbook explanations, generating boilerplate and debugging code, automating tedious tasks, and finding resources (textbooks, code, tutorials, etc.). It can accelerate learning and shift the focus off some less rewarding tasks if used properly.
On the other hand, the purist approach of completely abstaining from using it is also appealing to me, just like how film photography is appealing because of its manual, tactile nature. One prompt could generate a photo that realizes my vision with a high degree of accuracy, synthetic film grain and all, but the satisfaction of the process is traded for ease and “perfection”. Prompting doesn’t compare to the joy of finding an algorithm for a difficult programming problem, figuring out an elegant math problem, getting out into the world with a camera, or crafting a thoughtfully worded paragraph through personal effort, even if those processes don’t result in “perfection”. Often, what’s gained through the process outweighs the goal, and true satisfaction comes from having developed the skills yourself to self-sufficiently realize that goal. For this site, the process is the goal. There’s plenty of mathematics, stats, computer science, and public safety domain-specific resources that are far better than what I can offer here. This site will focus on my learning process and showcase some of its results. Posting my content online just holds me to a higher standard of completion.
So, how will I use AI?

Writing: Every post, analysis, and conclusion on this site is mine.
Photography: All photography on this site is mine, and no generative AI is used to create or edit them.
Code: I write my own code. I may use online references for assistance which I will cite. I won’t post code I don’t understand.
Research: All research is conducted using non-AI sources (to the best of my ability) and will be cited properly.

I am responsible for all content on this site.
